source: Evergreen picks checked on official sites (huntermuseum.org, chattzoo.org, seerockcity.com), Nov 2026; dinner, lunch and drinks picks to be added in a later weekly update

spots.name: Hunter Museum of American Art
spots.blurb: American art on a bluff over the river. $20 adults and free for 17 and under; closed Tuesdays.
spots.blurbEs: Arte estadounidense sobre un risco junto al río. $20 adultos y gratis para menores de 17; cierra los martes.

spots.name: Walnut Street Bridge
spots.blurb: A historic walking bridge with river and skyline views between downtown and the North Shore.
spots.blurbEs: Un puente peatonal histórico con vistas al río y a la ciudad, entre el centro y North Shore.

spots.name: Chattanooga Zoo
spots.blurb: A compact city zoo in Warner Park that hosts the Asian Lantern Festival on winter evenings.
spots.blurbEs: Un zoológico urbano compacto en Warner Park que en las noches de invierno presenta el Asian Lantern Festival.

spots.name: Rock City Gardens
spots.blurb: Rock trails and gardens atop Lookout Mountain.
spots.blurbEs: Senderos entre rocas y jardines en la cima de Lookout Mountain.

spots.name: Chattanooga Choo Choo
spots.blurb: The restored Terminal Station, now a hotel and entertainment campus with shops and gardens.
spots.blurbEs: La antigua Terminal Station, restaurada y convertida en hotel y centro de entretenimiento con tiendas y jardines.
